tasks.title: Lecture #66
tasks.instruction: Listen to a talk in a psychology class.
tasks.transcript:
Resilience refers to the ability to adapt and recover from adversity or stress. It's a dynamic process that varies significantly from person to person, influenced by a combination of genetic, psychological and social factors.
Research has shown that certain traits and behaviors can enhance resilience. These include optimism, the ability to regulate emotions and having a strong support network. For instance, people who maintain a positive outlook are better equipped to handle setbacks because they tend to see challenges as temporary and surmountable.
Emotional regulation involves managing one's feelings in a healthy way, which can prevent stress from becoming overwhelming.
Moreover, social connections play a crucial role in resilience. Support from family and friends can provide emotional comfort and practical assistance during difficult times. Communities with strong social bonds typically exhibit higher levels of collective resilience, which is the ability of a group to recover from crisis.
Next, we will discuss various strategies that individuals can use to build and strengthen their resilience over time.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the talk?

options.B: The ability to respond to difficulties
options.C: The role of genetics in psychological traits
options.D: The impact of social connections on adversity

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：这段谈话的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：Resilience refers to the ability to adapt and recover from adversity or stress. （全文围绕 resilience 的定义、影响因素、特征以及如何提升展开） 选项分析： A. The importance of emotional regulation 情绪调节的重要性。谈话中提到情绪调节是 resilience 的一个方面，但不是主要内容，所以A选项错误。 B. The ability to respond to difficulties 应对困难的能力。resilience 正是指适应和从逆境/压力中恢复的能力，所以B选项正确。 C. The role of genetics in psychological traits 遗传在心理特征中的作用。谈话中提到遗传是影响因素之一，但不是主要内容，所以C选项错误。 D. The impact of social connections on adversity 社会关系对逆境的影响。谈话中提到社会关系对 resilience 的作用，但不是主要内容，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what is one characteristic of resilience?

options.A: The tendency to avoid difficult situations
options.B: The habit of offering practical assistance to others
options.C: The view of problems as being temporary
options.D: The desire to limit one's ties to family and friends

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：根据说话者，resilience 的一个特征是什么？ 定位原文：For instance, people who maintain a positive outlook are better equipped to handle setbacks because they tend to see challenges as temporary and surmountable. 选项分析： A. The tendency to avoid difficult situations 逃避困难情况的倾向。resilience 是应对而非逃避，所以A选项错误。 B. The habit of offering practical assistance to others 向他人提供实际帮助的习惯。谈话中未提及，所以B选项错误。 C. The view of problems as being temporary 将问题视为暂时的看法。说话者说乐观的人将挑战视为“temporary and surmountable”（暂时的、可克服的），所以C选项正确。 D. The desire to limit one's ties to family and friends 限制与家人和朋友联系的欲望。谈话中提到 strong support network（强大的支持网络）有助于 resilience，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: Why does the speaker mention communities with strong social bonds?

options.A: To provide an example of the relationship between social connections and resilience
options.B: To explain how genetic factors influence collective resilience
options.C: To discuss the impact of physical health on collective resilience
options.D: To illustrate the importance of financial assistance

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：说话者为什么提到具有强大社会联系的社区？ 定位原文：Communities with strong social bonds typically exhibit higher levels of collective resilience... （前文提到 social connections play a crucial role in resilience） 选项分析： A. To provide an example of the relationship between social connections and resilience 举例说明社会联系与 resilience 之间的关系。说话者用社区例子说明社会联系如何提升 collective resilience，所以A选项正确。 B. To explain how genetic factors influence collective resilience 解释遗传因素如何影响集体 resilience。谈话中未提及，所以B选项错误。 C. To discuss the impact of physical health on collective resilience 讨论身体健康对集体 resilience 的影响。谈话中未提及，所以C选项错误。 D. To illustrate the importance of financial assistance 说明经济援助的重要性。谈话中未提及，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What will the speaker discuss next?

options.B: Ways that people can increase their resilience
options.C: The impact of mental health on resilience
options.D: Different types of stress and their effects on resilience

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：说话者接下来将讨论什么？ 定位原文：Next, we will discuss various strategies that individuals can use to build and strengthen their resilience over time. 选项分析： A. The genetic basis of resilience resilience 的遗传基础。谈话中已提及遗传是影响因素之一，但明确说接下来是 strategies，所以A选项错误。 B. Ways that people can increase their resilience 人们可以增强 resilience 的方法。说话者明确说“strategies that individuals can use to build and strengthen their resilience”，所以B选项正确。 C. The impact of mental health on resilience 心理健康对 resilience 的影响。谈话中未明确提及接下来要讲这个，所以C选项错误。 D. Different types of stress and their effects on resilience 不同类型的压力及其对 resilience 的影响。谈话中未明确提及，所以D选项错误。
